prompts.name: a-pixel-command-os
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a beautiful highly art-directed full desktop web application screenshot for POWER AGENTS, an AI collaboration platform entirely designed as a 32-bit-era pixel-art game interface. Landscape 1536x1024. The ENTIRE INTERFACE is pixel art: bitmap typography, stepped window corners, chunky pixel bevels, pixel icons, segmented progress bars, carefully limited color ramps, tactile pixel buttons, pixel cursors and pixel tabs. Rich coherent console-era craft, clean readable UI. No modern SaaS cards, no smooth vector typography, no blur or painterly smoothing, no photographic monitor or physical desk. This is the actual screen edge to edge.
Reference image is the approved city encounter and Ranger identity/weapon reference. Preserve orange/cream Claude with straight rigid copper bo staff, blue-periwinkle/white Codex with simple straight narrow silver saber, multicolor-accent Gemini with compact blaster; chunky full-body sprites, triangular squad facing generic tokusatsu villains on a side-on modern city street. Preserve recognizable costumes and weapon geometry as closely as possible. Match visible crisp pixel clusters across UI and scene.
Make a usable real productivity interface inside this visual world. Include nav New task / Runs / Connections, current run 'PRODUCT RESEARCH', state 'PLAN APPROVED', real task progress '1 / 4 TASKS COMPLETE', agent names and run-specific roles, task list with Complete / Working / Waiting, team chat, results tab, Pause and a text composer 'Message the team'. No fake coins, XP, HP, combat stats or game currencies. Small footer 'VISUAL CONCEPT / SAMPLE DATA'. Main content should feel alive and charming yet legible. Meaningful text, generous line spacing, deliberate hierarchy. Direction A: PIXEL COMMAND OS. A richly designed late-1990s futuristic desktop operating system for the Ranger squad. Ink navy workspace, cobalt and periwinkle titlebars, silver pixel-bevel window edges, warm amber selected controls, tiny mechanical fasteners and pixel status lamps used sparingly. Strong top menu masthead POWER AGENTS with tiny helmet emblem. Slim left icon+label dock, generous central city encounter window, right stacked task and team transmission windows, bottom message command strip. Nested windows like an elegant game command center. Pixel icons feel handcrafted, not generic. Maintain breathable spacing. Distinct tiny Ranger portraits in chat. Scene about 45% of screen.
